open.description: [suggestion] Voice/text meal logging: speak or type what you ate in your own words and let the coach AI parse it into a food entry, instead of only manual fields or a photo. USER PROBLEM: Add Custom Meal (src/components/nutrition/CustomMealModal.tsx) only takes manual name/calories/macro fields today -- no free-text or voice path exists (grepped: no parse/describe/freeform handling in that modal, no SpeechRecognition usage anywhere in src). Snap-to-log (photo, i-20260706-sn4p) covers the visual case but not hands-busy moments (cooking, eating out, driving) or dishes that photograph poorly (mixed thali, soup, chai+snack). Competitors (MyFitnessPal voice log, Cal AI) ship this; NYUS has neither text-freeform nor voice entry. EVIDENCE: backend already has an LLM meal-estimation path for the photo flow (llm_service.py) -- the same prompt pattern (food description -> structured items+macros) can be reused for a transcript/typed string, so this is largely a UI + one new endpoint, not new AI infra. Also ties into the in-flight i18n directive: Hindi/Hinglish speech-to-text + parsing is a natural differentiator for the India-focused base. V1 SCOPE: in the Add Custom Meal sheet, add a "Describe it" text field (mic button using the Web Speech API on web / native STT on Capacitor where available, falling back to typed text) -> POST the transcript to a new /api/v1/nutrition/parse-meal-text endpoint -> LLM returns items+macros -> prefill the existing manual fields, editable before save (same edit-then-confirm pattern already used for photo logging). No new logging surfaces, no schema changes to DailyLog. EFFORT: ~1-2 days FE (mic capture + prefill wiring reusing existing food-item form) + ~0.5 day BE (one endpoint, reuse llm_service prompt scaffolding).
